blob_acknowledgements.method: Every create_blob returned the exact locally computed Git blob SHA after local size and SHA-256 verification.

encoding: Lossless binary parts concatenated in manifest order; direct NPZ retained verbatim. No regeneration or recompression.
whole_file_git_sha_semantics: For multipart originals, git_blob_sha is the independently computed Git blob digest of the complete original; the whole original is reconstructed locally and is not claimed as a separately uploaded Git blob.
